tagline: 美能达便携相机，1987 年发布
description: 美能达于1987年推出的便携相机。配备1:3,5/35mm, switchable to 1:5,6/50mm。infrared。

specs.曝光测光: subject weighted metering, programmed automatic exposure
specs.取景器: magnification changes when lens is switched.
specs.英文简介: The Weathermatic 35DL issued by Minolta in 1987 is basically the same dual-focus compact camera as the Minolta AF-DL.
